facts.fact_text: As a reaction to the arrest of a peaceful protester in front of the Prosecutor General's Office on 29 January 2009, the applicant organisations decided to hold a demonstration in front of the Prosecutor General's Office.

On 2 February 2009 the first and the second applicants lodged a notification with the municipal authorities stating their intention to conduct a demonstration in front of the Prosecutor General's Office, followed by a march to the Ministry of Internal Affairs and a demonstration in front of the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
On 3 February 2009 the first and the second applicants organised a protest demonstration in front of the Prosecutor General's Office.
From the video submitted by the parties, it appears that approximately twenty individuals took part in the demonstration on 3 February 2009 in front of the Prosecutor General's Office.
The third applicant was among the participants in the demonstration on 3 February 2009 in front of the Prosecutor General's Office.
From the very beginning of the gathering on 3 February 2009, four uniformed police officers observed the event from a patrol car parked close to the place of the event.
When the clash between the protesters and the attackers began on 3 February 2009, no police officer intervened.
The protesters called the police and requested assistance during the attack on 3 February 2009, but received no assistance.
A police patrol appeared only one hour and a half after the attack began on 3 February 2009.
No action was taken in respect of the applicants' complaint about the inaction of the police during the attack on 3 February 2009.
